articles.description: NALSAR students are firm on their demand for Chief Justice of India Surya Kant not attending the convocation. articles.title: Michigan shooting: 5 killed, 1 critically injured, gunman found dead after manhunt
articles.description: Five people died in a northern Michigan shooting on Friday. The suspected gunman was later found dead after a large search. The circumstances surrounding the deaths and the motive remain under investigation.

articles.title: Meet Anusha Arora, the 15-year-old Washington student who built an AI music therapy platform using finger sensors and won $50,000
articles.description: Anusha Arora, a 15-year-old student from Bellevue, Washington, has won $50,000 at Regeneron ISEF 2026 for Harmony, an AI-powered music therapy platform. Using finger sensors and 11 AI programmes, the device detects emotions and generates personalised music and visuals. Inspired by her mother, Arora found the platform reduced stress and anxiety while improving engagement.
